attributes.action: make it illegal for british schools to physically run in over 32 degree heat
attributes.background: we believe that students in schools may struggle to concentrate in lessons, many prone to fainting as heatwaves are coming often this summer. to prevent children from heat stroke and other life threatening emergencies, schools need to be careful, ensuring kids are safe in extreme heat around school.

rejection.details:
